note: THE SUB-FLOOR ROSTER CANNOT HEAL ITSELF: EVERY GREEN STAGE GATE REWRITES IT INTO A WORKTREE THAT THE NEXT DISPATCH WIPES. Measured today. The commit gate runs exactly docs/timings/subfloor-roster.tsv, and a test absent from it is not in the commit gate at all. The documented remedy is that a test enters on the next green stage gate. Mechanically that is true, and durably it is false: the green gate writes the new roster into the lane SCRATCH worktree, scripts/lane-run.sh contains no git commit and no git push anywhere, and the next dispatch does checkout --force plus reset --hard on that same worktree. The runner header already documents exactly this shape for timed.sh docs/timings.md row and solves it by writing those numbers to jobs.tsv instead; the roster got no equivalent. PROOF IT HAS NEVER HEALED: git log --follow on the roster shows exactly TWO commits ever, both from The Staff, one of them authoring the file by hand. WHAT THIS COST: hornvale-hearsay was the ONLY workspace crate absent from the roster, so the commit gate compiled that crate and ran ZERO of its tests from the moment campaign 1 merged. Every green commit gate anyone ran was green about everything except that crate. I harvested the roster from a green run and committed it on campaign/the-retelling: 95 entries gained, below-floor 2748 to 2843, including 32 hearsay tests. THE GENERAL SHAPE: an allow-list gate cannot see that its list went short, and a self-updating artifact written to scratch is not self-updating. If you rely on a green stage gate to enrol your tests, check that the file actually moved in git afterwards.
